req.title: Reject wrong method on /patch
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 405 for methods other than PATCH on /patch.

doc.reasoning: The requirement states that /patch must accept PATCH and reject all other HTTP methods with 405. I design: (1) a positive test confirming PATCH returns 200 with expected JSON keys; (2) negative tests for GET, POST, PUT, DELETE each expecting exactly 405; (3) a boundary/decision-table test covering HEAD and OPTIONS (edge-case methods) also expecting 405. Each test asserts exact status codes to catch comparison-operator mutations, and the positive test asserts exact response keys to catch payload mutations.

tests.name: test_patch_method_returns_200_with_expected_payload
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
expected: JSON body contains keys: url, args, form, data, origin, headers, files, json
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_patch_method_returns_200_with_expected_payload():
    r = client.patch('/patch')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.get_json()
    assert isinstance(body, dict)
    for key in ('url', 'args', 'form', 'data', 'origin', 'headers', 'files', 'json'):
        assert key in body

test_patch_method_returns_200_with_expected_payload()

preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: Assert status code is exactly 200, not 201 or 204
trace: view_patch returns jsonify(...) which Flask sets to 200

from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_patch_status_code_is_exactly_200_not_201_or_204():
    r = client.patch('/patch')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    assert r.status_code != 201
    assert r.status_code != 204

tests.name: test_patch_with_json_body_returns_200_and_echoes_json
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: Send PATCH request to /patch with JSON body {"key": "value"}
trace: view_patch calls get_dict with 'json' key, helpers.py get_dict parses request.data
tests.executable:
import json
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_patch_with_json_body_returns_200_and_echoes_json():
    payload = {"key": "value"}
    r = client.patch(
        '/patch',
        data=json.dumps(payload),
        content_type='application/json'
    )
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.get_json()
    assert body['json'] == {"key": "value"}

test_patch_with_json_body_returns_200_and_echoes_json()
